description: Source code implementing time zone parsing functions for POSIX time zone specifications within the Abseil C++ library, including parsing of abbreviations, offsets, and date/time specifications.

methods.name: ParseInt
methods.description: Parses an integer within specified bounds from a string pointer.

methods.name: ParseAbbr
methods.description: Parses a timezone abbreviation, either in <...> format or as a string of at least 3 non-digit, non-sign characters.

methods.name: ParseOffset
methods.description: Parses a time offset in hours, minutes, and seconds, with optional sign.

methods.name: ParseDateTime
methods.description: Parses date/time specifications in various formats (e.g., Jn, n, Mm.w.d) and optional offset.
